title: Display flicker or backlight issue
description: Screen flickers or backlight intermittently. Ask for screenshots or video, serial number, OS and driver versions.
troubleshooting_steps: Ask user to reproduce and record short video of the flicker.
Request serial number and OS version (Windows/macOS) and display driver version.
On Windows: instruct user to update GPU drivers and check Device Manager for display adapter errors.
On macOS: request system report and advise SMC/PRAM reset steps.
If under warranty and hardware evidence present, escalate for RMA with photos and video.

title: Touchscreen unresponsive
description: Touch input not registering. Clarify recent drops/liquid exposure and ask for reproducing steps.
troubleshooting_steps: Ask whether the device is in tablet/portrait mode and if a stylus is paired.
On Windows: check HID-compliant touch screen in Device Manager, roll back or reinstall drivers.
On macOS (e.g., Touch Bar or touchscreen-like devices): request system profiler and logs.
Ask to reboot into safe mode to rule out third-party drivers.
If hardware fault suspected, collect photos and escalate.

title: Battery drains quickly
description: Device battery discharges faster than expected. Gather OS, battery health, and background app info.
troubleshooting_steps: Ask user for estimated battery cycles and battery health (Windows PowerShell or macOS System Report).
Request a screenshot of battery health and recent activity.
Advise updating firmware/BIOS and OS to latest version.
If battery health below threshold and device under warranty, create RMA.

title: Overheating / performance throttling
description: Device gets hot or throttles under load. Collect logs, temps, and reproduction steps.
troubleshooting_steps: Ask for exact workloads (e.g., game title + settings, CAD export step).
Request temps (HWMonitor on Windows or iStat on macOS) and a short video of fans/behavior.
Advise running a stress test to capture thermal profile and FPS logs.
If thermal paste / fan failure suspected, escalate to repair.

title: Wi-Fi disconnects frequently
description: Intermittent Wi-Fi issues. Determine whether it's device or network.
troubleshooting_steps: Ask whether other devices are affected and request router model.
Ask for OS and driver version, and advise re-installing Wi-Fi driver.
Collect system logs and a short capture of disconnection event.
If hardware NIC failure suspected, escalate.
